title: PersonnelGroupings
description: The offensive personnel-grouping reference — the standard two-digit RB/TE codes (00 through 32). A formation's `personnel` field foreign-keys into a `code` here. Validates the single file data/concepts/personnel-groupings.yaml.

groupings.description: Every personnel grouping, one entry per two-digit code.

code.description: Two-digit code: first digit = running backs, second digit = tight ends. The remaining skill spots (of five, excluding the QB) are wide receivers.

description.description: What the grouping is and what it signals to a defense.

typical_use.description: When and why an offense calls this grouping.

example_formations.description: Formation ids in data/formations/ that field this grouping.
